decisions.reason: The system involved substantial investment and the pandemic-related demand dip is treated as temporary, so management persists.
The arena system required significant investment and COVID-19 disruptions are seen as temporary, justifying continued commitment.
Like product B, the mobile arena system has high sunk costs and temporary pandemic effects, so dropping is unlikely.
The chevron parquet is central to the style-oriented direction and was prominently featured, so the firm remains committed.
The squash court finish required limited investment and is peripheral to the announced direction, so there is little to justify keeping it.
As a low-investment accessory with no centrality, the firm can drop it without significant write-off or justification.
